description: The public sample audit's findings: each a template sentence over its numbers, with the evidence tier, sample size and the evidence ids it rests on. Filter by kind: gap_driver, contact_reason, evidence_tier, judge_validation, provenance, window_sensitivity, no_request, handoff_outcome, claim_rule, rule_choice. A vendor's published score lists its drivers only (it quotes no conversation).

vendor.description: A published vendor's profile slug, e.g. "acme-ai-resolve-bot". Omit for the public sample audit (synthetic demo data, labelled as such).
